subject: E-Commerce
title: Walmart's Marketplace Ambitions
description: A 60-second lesson on Walmart's Marketplace Ambitions.

hook.text: Walmart's marketplace grew 500% in 3 years. It's using 4,700 physical stores as fulfillment centers to challenge Amazon.

buildup.text: Walmart realized its store network is a logistics edge no online-only competitor can match. Every store ships orders.

discovery.text: Walmart Fulfillment Services mirrors FBA but with lower fees. Sellers get access to Walmart's 120 M monthly visitors.

twist.text: Walmart's marketplace still has only 150K sellers vs Amazon's 2 million. Selection remains the critical gap.

climax.text: Walmart's physical stores are its weapon. Combining online marketplace with physical distribution is a unique strategy.

punchline.text: The goal is not certainty, but sharper thinking.

quiz.question: What is Walmart's unique advantage over Amazon in the marketplace war?
options: 4,700 physical stores that double as fulfillment centers for online orders
